text: opened the forest of wholesomememes for the second pass: B1d reads concepts and forests; group 1 (the B1c test found gates failing in t07, t09, t10, t12, t13 and t15) and a contrary room

After the B1d-04 compaction, one read ran before the reconciliation: the first 22 KB of the wholesomememes concept print (a TMPDIR file written before the compaction). No write ran before it. Slips so far: one call at B1d-01, one read at B1d-02, two reads at B1d-03, one read at B1d-04.

B1d room wholesomememes (order 351, group 1: the B1c test found gates failing in t07, t09, t10, t12, t13 and t15; and a contrary room) reread: A1 note, 25 second-order themes with every concept's words, and the forest whole (58 threads, 394 lines, not cut). Two moves, each with a tier line (tier_history 89 lines). t12 (members proposing pranks to play on friends off the site, c0056, c0065) moved from T3-001 to T3-017: the B1b-20 line keeps the members' own staged jokes and the replies inside them in T3-001, and t12 stages no fake; it is the same April Fools talk as t14, a father's prank story, in T3-017. t13 (trading outside creators' own April Fools releases, WeRateDogs c0057 and Ross Scott c0060) moved from T3-017 to T3-048 under the B1b-20 rule for a creator's own joke, as magictcg t04 and scp t06 took it. Kept: t07 in T3-003 (one member's own five pixels and smiley face, c0038, c0042; not the room's mark, so not T3-038); t09 in T3-016 (asking how elaborate art is possible under the timer and a placing glitch explained, c0043, c0044; with rotmg t14, the T3-016/T3-074 discriminator owed for B1e); t10 as its rule 0 line (T3-017 with T3-063): moderators routing posts to sister subs of the network; T3-015 was weighed and set aside, since t10 does not route canvas talk into one thread and c0047 has no canvas tie; t15 in T3-063 (the B1e rename covers April Fools posts). Peripheral concepts named here: c0172 (a defender with three alt accounts against the void, inside the t05 bag under T3-005, near T3-088); c0103 (someone made the S in Sweden a swastika, inside t19, near T3-146). National content read plainly: Sweden and Norway 'coexisting' and 'brothership' (c0084, c0085); Greece and Turkey, 'two fellow countries who have had bitter histories together getting along' (c0189, c0201) and whether the heart is Cyprus (c0202); Brazil and Argentina's 'historical grudge (football + others)' (c0223), raids then peace treaties with Finland and a 'Cross Continental Coalition' (c0240 to c0242); South Africa 'just standing there' (c0231). The A1 note's 'not this' holds: 'There's no official Wholesome Memes project' (c0143), most canvas posts were removed (t03, t15, t18), and LOVE 'naturally turned into Love' from a doodle (c0176). No new kind; the run is not reset.
opened the forest of placestart for the second pass: B1d reads concepts and forests; a contrary room

B1d room placestart (order 354, contrary room) reread: A1 note, 17 second-order themes with every concept's words, and the forest whole (424 threads, 1,565 lines, not cut). No change. The rule 0 lines and bags hold: building and repairing (t01 T3-038 with T3-021), templates (t02 T3-070 with T3-091 and T3-008), scripts (t03 T3-028 with T3-027 and T3-089), recruiting (t04 T3-002 with T3-084 and T3-069), the Discord (t05 T3-014), pleas to stop (t06 T3-139, 61 concepts), fitting threatened art into windows and icons (t07 bag under T3-012, 75 concepts), treaties (t08 bag under T3-010), design proposals (t09 T3-004), pressing onward (t10 T3-061 with T3-046), resistance (t11 bag under T3-046), thanks (t12 T3-009 with T3-072), status and who speaks (t13 T3-073 with T3-126), defence (t14 bag under T3-005), calls to replace other work (t15 bag under T3-006), jokes (t16 T3-031), the successor canvas (t17 T3-054 with T3-117). Peripheral concepts named here: c0477, a member answering the room's agreement to stop at 962 (c0399) with 'I will not obey the current treaty', near T3-102 defying the room's call to hold back; one concept in t10, not a carrying code, so no second kind. c0166, a member placing 'as many tiles as I please' through a glitch, near T3-088 (the T3-074/T3-088 glitch question for B1e). c0137, an outside room saying placestart's 'volunteers' still follow the wrong template, an outside voice for the T3-188 gate question. c0122, a member saying treaties 'declared by the mods or not' do not stop the deleting. National and political content read plainly: the deal with France over the Eiffel Tower (c0098, c0120, c0296), 'The French problem....' (c0282), 'Screw the Eiffel Tower' (c0349), and a critic from France saying there was no compromise and asking who speaks for whom (thread 632c5f, uncoded apart from c0272 and c0340, 'we will declare war and ally with the many other works of art you are systematically destroying'); Iceland's border (c0300, c0459; an uncoded 'We at /r/Iceland will not quietly sit' and '/r/FlagAlliance will hear of this!'); 'European solidarity', branding Remain across the Union Jack (c0415); clutter on the Indian flag (c0208); the Philippine flag and nearby flags (c0429); Greenland (c0285), Texas (c0292), a human equality flag (c0312); a plan for a hammer and sickle (c0281); 'Do not cover up the blue KKK Member', the Earthbound cultist figures (c0284); 'Manifest Destiny!' (c0347); 'the meek are eaten by the strong' (c0409). The A1 note's 'not this' holds: no single conqueror; the room ran treaties and icons (t07, t08) while its own builders and scripts overran them (c0053, c0133, c0357, c0477). No new kind; the run is not reset.
opened the forest of UNLincoln for the second pass: B1d reads concepts and forests; a contrary room

B1d room UNLincoln (order 358, contrary room) reread: A1 note, 2 second-order themes with every concept's words, and the forest whole (1 thread, 2 items, both coded). No change. A member's call to fix 'Our logo in the bottom left corner', filling in with black, under an hour before the close (t01 T3-021, c0001), and another member's answer after it, 'Because its not ours, its Northeastern' (t02 T3-043, c0002), hold every concept. t02 corrects which university made the logo; it does not dispute a nation's belonging, so T3-180 does not apply. The episode is already recorded: E470 joins this room with neu over Northeastern's N taken for Nebraska's. The A1 note's 'not this' holds: the room built no mark; it called to repair a logo a member said belonged to Northeastern. No new kind; the run is not reset.
opened the forest of ukplace for the second pass: B1d reads concepts and forests; a contrary room

B1d room ukplace (order 371, contrary room) reread: A1 note, 9 second-order themes with every concept's words, and the forest whole (33 threads, 178 lines, not cut). No change. The rule 0 lines and bags hold: the master script run from Discord (t01 bag under T3-028), additions to the flag (t02 bag under T3-113), pixel deals with neighbours (t03 bag under T3-010), helping the American flag and Mexico against the void (t04 T3-011 with T3-005 and T3-072), pride (t05 T3-009), scripts called fair play (t06 T3-027 with T3-046), what the scripts wiped out (t07 bag under T3-046), banter and thanks after the row (t08 T3-155 with T3-157), the end (t09 T3-117 with T3-105 and T3-054). Peripheral concepts named here, for the B1e question whether 'it was not us' counts for T3-188 (an organised room telling others it does not control placers acting in its name): c0033, an outside member reporting that the room's people 'claim no knowledge and that they are only running scripts to defend the UK Flag'; c0088, a member saying 'there may have been some with active botnets, the UK was only ever scripting'; c0091, 'our flag hasn't expanded'; c0067, a member blaming 'the brash and aggressive stance of much of the UK discord & scripters' for the lost text, an inside blame with no disowning. None is central or a carrying code (c0009, c0038, c0081), so no second kind. c0017, a member posting from 'one of my bot account tabs', near T3-120 and T3-088. National and political content read plainly: Scotland and Northern Ireland 'getting invaded by a unholy alliance of irishmen, scotnats and canadian hockey fans' (c0003); the master script that 'could very easily be changed to draw a giant swastika during the night' (c0011); proposing propaganda 'to say we are fighting against the void while we establish colonies' (c0044), refused (c0045); 'cease all extra-jurisdictional excursions into Mexican living space' (c0053) under a thread title parodying 'First they came'; a reported 'alliance between ukflag, thedonald and void to destroy mexico', called shame to the flag (c0055); the poppy, and the overwrite defended as a war memorial and contested (c0072, c0073, c0077); Theresa May proposed under the flag and refused (c0058, c0059); 'bringing the worst out in the various nationalities' (c0036); Italian and Commonwealth allies thanked (c0084); 'A man from Tennessee' speaking for those overwritten (c0071). The A1 note's 'not this' holds: a late room that expanded by script over others (t01, t07). No new kind; the run is not reset.
